handback.title: A changelog lists what v0.1.0 does
handback.summary: The repo gains a changelog whose v0.1.0 section lists what that version does.
handback.user_story: Owners read in one changelog what Dokima's first version, v0.1.0, does.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the changes land, the repo's changelog has a v0.1.0 section listing what that version does.
acceptance_criteria.words: the changelog listing what v0.1.0 does

edge_cases.case: The v0.1.0 heading has nothing listed under it.
The changelog has no heading naming v0.1.0.

raises.label: List checked by reading
raises.text: A test only checks the list exists. Is your reading at approval enough to judge it true? Plan assumes yes.
raises.evidence: `tests/test_changelog.py::test_changelog_lists_v010` checks a v0.1.0 section with at least one list item.
